title: CPI: 6%. WPI: 12%. If you have a loan, watch this. #Shorts
description:
India's WPI hit 12.29% in October 2026 — the 2nd straight double-digit month.

CPI is 6.09%. WPI is 12.29%. That gap is widening, and it flows through fuel, manufactured goods, and food.

This video covers:
• What's driving WPI (fuel 32.84%, manufactured 9.54%, food 8.58%)
• Why the CPI vs WPI gap matters for EMI borrowers
• What Dec RBI might do next
• The key numbers to watch
